propositions: JiraConfig accepts non-https (http://) jira.url silently without validation, risking cleartext credential exposure in transit
DC's ReconcilerConfig validates https scheme via _validate_reconciler_tls and raises ConfigError unless allow_insecure is set, but JiraConfig has no equivalent __post_init__ validation
Three consumers of load_config().jira swallow ConfigError exceptions, allowing bad configs to degrade to env-only mode instead of failing loud
write_jira_config persists jira.url without scheme validation, allowing the onboarding wizard to silently write cleartext urls

The fix must introduce JiraConfig.__post_init__ validation, add allow_insecure boolean config option, enforce https-only in the write path, and make resolve_jira_settings fail-loud while preserving graceful detection in _jira_onboard
